Hymn 265: Arise, O God, and Shine
Time Signature: 3/4
Musical Key: C Major
Composer: Lorin F. Wheelwright
Lyricist/Text Author: William Hurn
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 265 titled "Arise, O God, and Shine" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in C Major with a 3/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Lorin F. Wheelwright and the lyrics were written by William Hurn.
This hymn is categorized under: Special Topics.
